title: Senior Meta Lead Gen Media Buyer | Remote | $3,000–$4,000 USD/Month
text: Senior Meta Lead Gen Media Buyer | Remote | $3,000–$4,000 USD/Month Ready to lead Meta strategy for an account with $10,000+ in daily ad spend ? I’m sharing an opportunity through Talented for an experienced media buyer to join a US legal lead generation company serving law firms. You’ll guide an existing buying team, lead creative testing, and work directly with the founder on campaign performance. Eligible locations: You must currently live in Argentina, South Africa, Brazil, or Colombia . Work setup: Full-time remote contractor role with daily overlap of US Eastern business hours. Compensation: $3,000–$4,000 USD per month, paid directly by the client. What you’ll do: Set the Meta campaign testing plan and budget strategy. Guide junior buyers on what to test, scale, and stop. Research competitors and develop fresh, compliant ad concepts. Evaluate CPL, qualified-lead quality, and client outcomes to improve performance. Share daily performance insights and recommended actions with the founder. You could be a strong fit if you have: Managed Meta lead generation budgets of $5,000+ per day . Directed other media buyers’ testing and scaling decisions. Turned Meta Ad Library research into effective, compliant creative concepts. Diagnosed and improved declining ad account performance. Strong professional English communication skills. A professional workstation with a webcam, noise-canceling headset, and stable internet of 25 Mbps or higher . Experience in US legal, personal injury, motor vehicle accident, or other high-ticket lead generation is a plus. Application process: A video application, skill assessment, video interview, compensated practical assessment, and client interview.
